item.title: Four Men Charged In Connection With Carrigaholt Post Office Robbery Further Remanded In Custody For Two Weeks
item.description: The four Clare men charged in connection with the robbery of Carrigaholt Post Office last Wednesday afternoon were all today further remanded in custody for a two week period. At Ennis District Court this morning, the four men appeared in court via video link from Limerick prison. item.title: Major Oil Spill On Main Ennis To Ennistymon Road
item.description: Emergency services are dealing with a significant oil spillage on the main N85 Ennis to Ennistymon road. Clare County Fire and Rescue Service crews from Ennis and Ennistymon stations are currently treating the road but this could take some time. Motorists are urged to drive with care.
